clean_repro.observed: API returns HTTP 200 with 5 results, accepting vector field as groupByField without validation

contract_refs: groupByField should only accept scalar/varchar fields for grouping, not vector fields

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Search HTTP handler → groupParams extraction → no field type validation check → pass-through to search execution
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:groupByField参数缺少字段类型校验。向量字段不支持分组操作(只有标量/字符串字段可以分组),但API未验证groupByField的数据类型,直接透传给执行层。这是参数校验缺失的真正缺陷

falsification.probe: Execute same search request multiple times to verify vector grouping is actually being attempted
falsification.observed: API consistently returns HTTP 200 with grouped results, proving the invalid groupByField is accepted without error

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus
cognition_match.note: 命中开发者认知盲点:REST v2 API缺少字段类型校验。groupByField接受向量字段属于参数验证不足的已知问题模式

verdicts.rationale: 实际复现成功:HTTP 200接受groupByField='vector'(向量字段)进行分组搜索。源码接地证实:缺少对groupByField的字段类型校验,向量字段不支持分组操作但仍被API接受。分组操作语义上仅适用于标量/字符串字段,向量字段分组无意义。这是参数验证缺失的真正缺陷,属于REST v2 API数据类型校验不足的已知盲点
